title: Universal Life Insurance Contract Provisions: Monthly Deduction, Interest and Index Crediting
content:
**Section 1 — Monthly anniversaries.** A monthly anniversary of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy falls on the issue date's day of the month, or on the last day of a shorter month.

**Section 2 — The monthly deduction.** On each monthly anniversary the monthly deduction is taken from the account value. It is the cost of insurance for the net amount at risk at the insured's attained-age rate, plus the tier's monthly policy fee, plus the tier's monthly expense charge per thousand of the initial face amount during the tier's expense charge years from issue. The policy fee and expense charge together are the monthly policy fee plus the initial face amount divided by one thousand times the per-thousand charge, that product rounded to the cent. No deduction is taken after the anniversary at the tier's maturity age, and coverage continues.

**Section 3 — Fixed-account interest.** Fixed-account value earns the tier's current fixed account rate, never less than the tier's guaranteed minimum interest rate, credited monthly. Loan collateral earns the credited rate of its loan type instead.

**Section 4 — Indexed account.** Money allocated to the indexed account waits in the fixed account until the next segment start day and then starts a segment of the tier's segment term. At the end of the segment it is credited at the S&P 500 point-to-point change times the participation rate, capped at the cap rate and never below the floor rate.

**Section 5 — Allocation changes.** An allocation change is accepted only while the policy status is in force or in the grace period, as the policy record shows. A new allocation applies to premium received after the change and does not move existing segments.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

*Expense part of the deduction.* An Ashgrove Accumulation UL with an initial face of $250000.00 in policy year 4: $10.00 policy fee plus 250 times $0.0800, $20.00, so $30.00 before the cost of insurance. In policy year 11 the per-thousand part no longer applies and $10.00 remains.

*Segment credit.* On an Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect segment (cap 9.5%, participation 100%, floor 0%):

| S&P 500 change over the segment | Change times participation | Credited rate |
|---|---|---|
| 12% | 12% | 9.5% (cap) |
| 7% | 7% | 7% |
| minus 3% | minus 3% | 0% (floor) |

*Waiting period.* Premium allocated to the indexed account and received on the 20th of a month waits in the fixed account until the 15th of the next month, when its segment starts.

*Allocation change.* An allocation change requested on a lapsed policy is not accepted; on a policy in the grace period it is.
